_description: Tier-B golden-coordinate integration fixtures (PROJECT_PLAN.md §6.4.2). Each point is run two ways that must agree: the live /assessment endpoint AND a direct tiles.legality_polygons most-restrictive point lookup. Coordinates are interior points (ST_PointOnSurface) of large, eyeball-stable PAD-US units, so they survive boundary shifts in an ETL re-run (e.g. PAD-US 4.2). 'expect' = final /assessment collectingStatus; 'tileBase' = the Stage-1 base verdict from the direct tile lookup (null = no polygon there). GREEN points were chosen with no recorded claim within ~2km so the live Stage-2 claims overlay does not flake the fixture. Run: scripts/run-tier-b.sh.
_note: Stage-2 live-claim escalation (open land + active claim -> YELLOW) is intentionally NOT a gating Tier-B fixture: it depends on the live BLM MLRS endpoint and is non-deterministic. It is covered by the live-claims integration path verified separately.
